**DK25.0** is a medical diagnosis code representing an acute gastric ulcer with hemorrhage (*akut mavesår med blødning*). Within the Danish healthcare system, it serves as a critical data point for monitoring patient safety and clinical outcomes, specifically within the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database managed by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP).

The primary significance of DK25.0 lies in its use as a quality indicator for patients diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]]. Because treatments for atrial fibrillation often involve anticoagulants, patients are at a higher risk for bleeding complications. To track the incidence of severe bleeding (*alvorlig blødning*) in this population, the national database utilizes a comprehensive set of ICD-10-DK diagnosis codes [^src1]. DK25.0 is specifically categorized under gastrointestinal bleeding, alongside a wide array of related codes such as [[dk25-2|DK25.2]], [[dk26-0|DK26.0]], [[dk28-0|DK28.0]], [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]], and [[dk92-0|DK92.0]] [^src1]. 

The database's methodology also tracks other severe bleeding events using distinct code groups, including intracranial hemorrhages (e.g., [[di60|DI60]], [[ds064|DS064]]) and urinary or respiratory tract bleeding (e.g., [[dj942|DJ942]], [[dn02|DN02]]) [^src1]. The precise definitions and applications of DK25.0 and its associated indicators are formally documented in the technical methodology sections of the 2023 and 2024 annual reports for atrial fibrillation in Denmark, ensuring standardized data collection and regional comparison across the country [^src1] [^src2].

## Claims
- For incidens af alvorlig blødning anvendes en bred vifte af diagnoser, herunder DI60–DS066 for intrakraniel blødning, DK25.0–DK29.8A og DK92.0–DK92.2 for gastrointestinal blødning samt DJ942, DN02, DR04 og DR31 for urinvejs-/lunge blødning [^src1] (di60, di61, di62, ds064, ds065, ds066, dk25-0, dk25-2, dk25-4, dk25-6, dk26-0, dk26-2, dk26-4, dk26-6, dk27-0, dk27-2, dk27-4, dk27-6, dk28-0, dk28-2, dk28-4, dk28-6, dk29-0, dk29-8a, dk92-0, dk92-1, dk92-2, dj942, dn02, dr04, dr31)
